question: Does an EMA temporal latent objective plus coordinate variance regularization improve observable autoregressive forecasting over an identical network given the same training CPU time?
contribution: A controlled applicability/falsification study of an Olympus prediction adaptation, not a new JEPA architecture or a language-model capability claim.

dynamics.integrator: classical RK4 in float64; each observation interval has four equal integration substeps
dynamics.units: dimensionless state and time; fully observed deterministic autonomous systems

data.provenance: New synthetic trajectories generated solely by the included equations/code; no external data or historical Hermes examples.
data.licensing: Repository ownership/license unchanged; no new rights or redistribution license granted.
data.ood_initial_state: q has equiprobable sign and Uniform[1.75,2.5] magnitude; v Uniform[-1.5,1.5]; dynamical law unchanged
data.normalization: Per-coordinate mean and population standard deviation from all training trajectory states only; std floor1e-6
data.noise_test: ID initial observation plus Gaussian noise of0.05 training standard deviations; future targets remain clean
data.missing_test: ID initial velocity replaced with zero in raw state space; diagnostic, no identifiability claim

model.activation: tanh between linear layers; biases on every linear layer
model.forward: z=E(x); z_next=z+P(z); x_next=D(z_next), all in training-normalized coordinates
model.target: Exact initial clone of E; gradients disabled; EMA after each optimizer update
model.variance_scope: Coordinate variance only; not full VICReg and not a guarantee against rank collapse
model.initialization: PyTorch Linear defaults, identical full initial state across neural arms within each family/replicate
model.sampling: Identical minibatch index stream prefix across neural arms; with replacement from all training transitions

development.selection: Lowest geometric mean20-step free-running development NMSE of the full arm across both seeds and both families; exact ties choose a. No other tuning.

confirmation.independent_unit: Eight paired blocks, each with independently generated train/evaluation trajectories and initialization, containing both fixed dynamical families
confirmation.primary_endpoint: Mean squared training-normalized state error, averaged equally across coordinates,20 forecast steps and trajectories, on amplitude-OOD initial conditions
confirmation.test: Predeclared one-sided exact sign test of positive block contrast, ties counted as non-wins; alpha0.05; one primary claim
confirmation.supported: 95% effect interval lower bound >=0.10 AND sign p<=0.05 AND positive average contrast in each family AND ID aggregate regression<=5% AND no candidate divergence AND valid CPU matching
confirmation.negative: Valid95% effect interval upper bound<0.10: predefined practical benefit is not supported in this scope
confirmation.mixed: Primary interval/sign criteria met but a prespecified family or ID guard fails
confirmation.inconclusive: Interval overlaps the practical threshold or resource/precision limits prevent the planned valid comparison
confirmation.invalid: Genuine protocol, implementation, leakage or analysis defect; retain original evidence and issue a separate corrected version

arms.direct: Same encoder/predictor/decoder, state and reconstruction losses; no latent/variance terms
arms.latent: direct plus selected temporal EMA latent term
arms.frozen_target: full with EMA momentum1; tests fixed versus moving targets
arms.shuffled_target: full with a separate deterministic permutation of only latent future targets inside each minibatch; supervised future labels unchanged
arms.direct_cpu_matched: Fresh direct arm, train until its process CPU training time reaches full-arm training CPU time; at most1500 updates; report overshoot and step count. Capped runs or relative time difference>5% invalidate matching.
arms.linear_ridge: Current normalized state monomials total degree<=1, intercept, ridge1e-6 on mean normal equations, intercept unpenalized
arms.cubic_ridge: Same with all monomials total degree<=3; no latent state, no teacher information

secondary: per-coordinate latent standard deviation and effective covariance rank
per-process peak RSS and host/cgroup preflight

failures.training_nonfinite: Retain failed arm receipt/checkpoint/log; no positive conclusion from an incomplete matrix
failures.rollout_divergence: State absolute value>1e6 or nonfinite: mark divergent, assign1e12 squared error for remaining steps; retain raw finite prefix and failure flag
failures.resource_failure: Stop the lane; retain partial outputs; do not rerun to obtain a favorable score
failures.exclusions: No completed seed, family, arm, or trajectory may be removed

evidence: Every attempt writes fresh output directory, source/config/data/checkpoint hashes, environment, all losses and forecasts, failures, timing, memory, and generation seeds. Confirmation additionally requires a source-bound frozen manifest.
